title: Sebastian and the Garden
author: Juniper Villalobos
blurb: Cyrus Amberdale, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent twenty years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
